scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n shared,server,web -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w packages/shared" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
